v2_vs_comp1_v2_bader.key_finding: PS4 charge polarization is REDUCED by Li vacancy. P +0.35 less cationic + S +0.07 less anionic in modelC. Li/Cl essentially identical between systems.
v2_vs_comp1_v2_bader.physical_explanation: In comp1 Li6 sublattice surrounds each PS4 fully -> strong Coulomb pull -> efficient P->S charge transfer. In modelC Li5.4 some PS4 face vacancies -> reduced electrostatic environment -> P retains more electrons -> less polarized PS4 unit.
v2_vs_comp1_v2_bader.implication_for_paper: Vacancy weakens not only ionic Li-X bonds (long-range) but also covalent PS4 polarization (short-range), explaining why Li5.4 family has lower B0 despite same PS4 topology.
